meta.story: Hotel restaurant GST: a room sold above Rs 7,500 last year makes the hotel's restaurant bills 18% with input credit instead of 5% without; Rizstay stay code and live orders

beats.headline: Don't bill hotel dinners at 5%.
beats.say: Hotel owners, your restaurant might be charging the wrong GST.
beats.tts: Hotel owners, your restaurant might be charging the wrong GST.

beats.label: RULE 1
beats.headline: Sold any room above ₹7,500 a night last financial year?
beats.say: Rule 1. Sold any room above ₹7,500 a night last financial year?
beats.tts: Rule one. Sold any room above seven thousand five hundred rupees a night, last financial year?

beats.label: RULE 1
beats.headline: Then your restaurant bills this year = 18% GST.
beats.say: Then your restaurant bills this year carry 18% GST. Not 5.
beats.tts: Then your restaurant bills this year carry eighteen percent GST. Not five.

beats.label: SAVE THIS · SEND IT TO YOUR CA
beats.headline: ₹2,000 dinner: 5% = ₹100 GST. 18% = ₹360 GST.
beats.say: A ₹2,000 dinner? That's ₹360 of GST, not ₹100. Send this to whoever does your billing.
beats.tts: A two thousand rupee dinner? That's three hundred and sixty rupees of GST, not one hundred. Send this to whoever does your billing.

beats.label: RULE 2
beats.headline: Every room ₹7,500 or less? 5%, but no input credit.
beats.say: Rule 2. Every room at ₹7,500 or less? Food stays at 5%, but you can't claim input credit.
beats.tts: Rule two. Every room at seven thousand five hundred or less? Food stays at five percent, but you can't claim input credit.

beats.label: RULE 3
beats.headline: On 18%, claim credit for the GST on what you buy.
beats.say: Rule 3. On the 18% side, you claim back the GST you paid on supplies.
beats.tts: Rule three. On the eighteen percent side, you claim back the GST you paid on supplies.

beats.label: RIZSTAY
beats.headline: Live orders update on every screen.
beats.say: In Rizstay, new, preparing and ready orders update live on every screen.
beats.tts: In Rizstay, new, preparing and ready orders update live on every screen.

beats.label: RIZSTAY
beats.headline: Stay code: guests see their own bill.
beats.say: Room guests type a private stay code. They see their stay, amenities and running bill.
beats.tts: Room guests type a private stay code. They see their stay, amenities and running bill.

beats.label: COMMENT RATE
beats.headline: Comment RATE. I'll DM the 1-page hotel food GST check.
beats.say: Comment RATE. I'll send you the 1 page check. Follow so my DM reaches you.
beats.tts: Comment RATE. I'll send you the one page check. Follow so my D M reaches you.
